summaryJa: INHERENT RESOLVE作戦のISRミッション報告。発信元は11 ATKS／432 AEW。機は281953Z OCT 25に離陸し、ステーションは290025Z OCT 25から291222Z OCT 25まで滞在、291605Zに着陸、291615Zにエンジン停止。フルモーションビデオは解析済み。UAP事象は290141Z〜290150Z OCT 25の間にセンサー映像上で観測され、観測者は「白い丸い軌跡」のように記述、追跡中に最大で約500 MPHの高速移動を観測し、その後（報告書内で特定箇所はぼかされている）付近で見失った。友軍機高度は約22,500 ftと記載。UAPは固体と記載され、人員への影響はなし。DoDによるUAP取得は290145Z OCT 25とされる。多くの運用・識別情報は報告書で秘匿されている。
summaryEn: ISR mission report for Operation INHERENT RESOLVE. Originator: 11 ATKS / 432 AEW. Aircraft departed 281953Z OCT 25, on station from 290025Z OCT 25 to 291222Z OCT 25, landed 291605Z and last engine shutdown at 291615Z. Full-motion video was exploited. A UAP was observed on sensor feed from 290141Z to 290150Z OCT 25; the observer described it as a white, round orbit, tracked it while it moved at speeds up to approximately 500 MPH, and subsequently lost it near a redacted location. Friendly aircraft altitude was about 22,500 ft. The UAP is reported as solid and caused no effects on personnel. DoD acquisition time for the UAP is listed as 290145Z OCT 25. Numerous operational and identifying details are redacted in the report.
